question: Does the complete scale-aware extent-guard chain localize wholly new door 8 in all three frozen queries?

selection.reference_scale: Median target bounding-box area fraction across the three frozen reference-memory views.
selection.extent_guard: For a full-frame proposal only, retain the proposal box when the SAM mask bbox retains less than 80 percent of proposal area; tiles and extent-stable full proposals retain SAM refinement.
selection.tie_break: Raw local appearance, final-layer memory score, objectness, box coordinates and proposal index.

evaluation.truth_role: Truth enters only after scale-aware ranking, SAM and the frozen provenance-aware extent guard.

literature_motivation.use: Intermediate DINOv2 features retain local part discrimination.
Whole-object proposal mining counters local-part masks.

forbidden_after_freeze: change family, rows, tiles, proposals, layer-18 score, scale penalty 0.05, extent retention 0.8, SAM or IoU gate
use query truth, sibling appearance, negative controls or target metrics in selection
retry, rescue, replace or remove a frozen query
claim_boundary: A pass is narrow same-provider new-family confirmation of an exact-instance localization component. It is not open-set rejection, provider-independent or raw-phone generalization, named entrance or portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, reliability or safety evidence.
